run_hplt_pipeline: run the HPLT multilingual dataset download pipeline using SlurmPipelineExecutor with custom HPLTReader
create_hplt_reader: create a custom HPLTReader class that extends JsonlReader to download and shard HPLT monolingual text files
build_hplt_reader_shard: build an HPLTReader instance that shards files by rank and world_size for distributed processing
test_hplt_reader_run: test the HPLTReader run method with custom rank and world_size parameters for data sharding
review_slurm_executor_config: review the SlurmPipelineExecutor configuration for running the HPLT download pipeline on a Slurm cluster
